1.title: Trump Says He May Drop Blanche’s Attorney General Nomination, for Now
1.summary: President Trump’s threat followed a day of fruitless negotiations with two Republican holdouts, Senators John Cornyn and Thom Tillis.

2.title: Former Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes Exits Race for Wisconsin Governor
2.summary: With a democratic socialist, Francesca Hong, leading in polls, former Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes said he was ending his campaign in the closely divided state.

3.title: Colin Gray, Father of Teenage Shooter in Georgia, Sentenced to 15 Years in Prison
3.summary: Prosecutors argued that Colin Gray bore responsibility for the 2024 shooting because he had given his son a gun and failed to act as the teen’s mental health deteriorated.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Saudis Seek Military Alliance to Protect Red Sea Shipping
4.summary: As the war between the United States and Iran widened, Saudi Arabia joined with over a dozen other countries, including Egypt and Turkey, to form a new defense coalition to stop attacks on shipping in the Red Sea.

5.title: Saudi Arabia Aims to Deter Red Sea Attacks With New Coalition
5.summary: Facing attacks by Yemen’s Houthi militia, Saudi Arabia has invited dozens of countries to assist it in protecting shipping in the Red Sea, diplomats say.

6.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
6.summary: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.
